changes.summary: Refresh package metadata when installing the hash-locked process so newly published releases remain visible through warm pip caches; remove the publication-time cache expiry wait. Consumer CI using pip 26.2 or newer should pass --refresh-package engineering-process, or use --no-cache-dir with older pip.

Reject recorded agent reviewer-context reuse across changes in the same repository and its worktrees. Preserve same-change correction reviews, and provide an audited replacement only for a reused initial assignment with no submitted review. Native fresh-session and unchanged model/effort evidence remain required from the host.
